lines.ur: Usay mainframe tak pohanchne mat dena! Har haal mein rokna hai.
Aur Rizwan... ab teri baari hai. Jab tak hum jeet nahi jaate, duniya mehfooz nahi hogi.
Nahi. Main nahi kar sakta. Hmm... lekin tere paas koi option bhi nahi hai.
Ruk! Bilkul sahi kaha, Rizwan. Pehle aaraam kar le. Aaraam.
Ho gaya, bahut kuch nikal liya. Lekin... sab kuch nikalna naamumkin hai.
Tujhe kaisa lag raha hai? Theek ho raha hai na? Rizwan!
Yahan aana teri badi ghalti thi!
Tum mujhe kabhi control nahi kar sakte! Please... main sirf yeh cheez nikalwana chahta hoon.
Ali! Aaj itni subah uth gaya? Aur Mama bhi hamesha subah practice karti thin. Tum toh aur bhi tez ho gaye ho.
Pehle Uncle ko dar lagta tha. Agar Ali ko Mama ke baare mein pata chal jaata, toh shayad woh agent nahi banna chahta. Lekin dekho, ab toh woh aur zyada jazbati hai.
Main bhi Mama ki tarah hi banna chahta hoon.
Mama ko aaj tum par fakr hota, Ali. Chal, main chalta hoon — Comot ko bhookha chhod diya toh woh naraz ho jayega.
Haan! Kaun sabse dair se aata hai? Chalo chalo. Papa abhi kaam par ja rahe hain? Pehle kuch kha lete hain.
Khaana? Beta, main toh abhi naya project shuru kar raha hoon. Lekin koi baat nahi, ab utna busy nahi hoon. Naye boss ki wajah se.
Naya boss, Datuk Isham. Aur Datuk Othman? Woh abhi bhi theek nahi hain. Dekho, yeh school se letter aaya hai.
Kya letter? STEM Club ki trip ki permission? Lekin humne toh yeh film abhi khatam bhi nahi ki thi, Comot!
Hello? Hey Ali! Dekho kis se mila! Aris! Lekin ab woh Agent Aris hai, yaad hai na? Bade ho gaye hain log. Ekdum ameer logon jaisa style!
Camera kidhar hai? Yeh sab kuch filma raha hai kya? Huri!

Sabko salaam! Agent Leon aaj nahi aa sakte — unka Sabaraya ke bahar kaam hai. Aur haan... ek naya imtihaan hoga. Kya academy abhi bhi band hai? Nahi, nayi jagah taiyaar hai. Yeh koi mazak nahi hai — camping trip, ijaazat mil gayi. Aur Ali, tumhe yeh A.I. kisne di?
Main tumhe sab yahan isliye bulaya hoon, kyunki yeh ek zaroori paighaam hai. Yeh coffee shop nahi hai ke tum log bakwas karte raho. Jo bhi dobara beech mein bolega...
Arre! Mil gaya!
Kya mil gaya?
Yeh kya hai?

Ijin, jari rakhna. Shukriya. Ab tum logon ko ek message milega jisme Rasia location ke coordinates hain. Yaad kar lena — yeh message 30 second mein delete ho jayega. Aur kal subah 8 baje tak wahan pahonchna hai. Koi sawaal? Ali!
Hum wahan ja kar kya karenge?
Wahan pahonch kar pata chal jayega. Coordinates pehle se yaad kar lo, samjhe? Itni der se kaam kar rahe ho, abhi tak nahi samjhe?
Humain is glitch ko theek karna hai. Hahaha! Danish abhi bhi peechay bhaag raha hai, hai na?
Danish? Ruko, Danish! Arre bhai, Danish kahan gaya?
Allah khair kare! Danish toh chala gaya! Danish kis se baat kar raha tha?
Danish, ruko!
Jaldi karo! Kitne log hain? Koi baat nahi, main kharcha utha rahi hoon. Ab batao, yeh jagah kya hai? Khud dekh lo.
Hum yahan se practice shuru karenge. Kaisa lag raha hai? Koi challenge lena chahta hai? Chalo, kiski power test karein?
Wawamak mil jaye toh maza aa jaye. Bahut din ho gaye practice kiye. Lekin main nahi bhaagta. Agli baar woh mujhe yahan se phir se milenge. Gita, kya hum pehle try kar sakte hain?
Hmm, theek hai. Lekin dhyan rakhna — koi zakhmi na ho. Woohoo! Yeah! Chris, Rudi, tum log mere saath. Chalo, power wale aage aao. Main kuch nahi chhoda.
Ali ke paas koi air-ji nahi hai jo kar sake. Hahaha! Jaldi karo, Comot! Theek hai, maaf karo. Lekin usne jo kaha, woh ghalat nahi tha. Toh tum log nahi aaoge?
Yeh modak kidhar hai? Arre, Ali kahan hai? Saat log ummeedwaar thay? Kahin power test karne gaye hain?
Leon abhi tak nahi aaye? Woh baaki participants ko lane gaye hain. Participants? Humari team se? Nahi, international team se. Humm, dhyan se suno — woh sab a rahe hain.
Chalo, ek aur point hasil karo. Yeh point kya hai? Yeh tumhara imtihaan hai.
Yeh mera ilaqa hai.

Haan, tumhe silat aati hai? Chalo dekhte hain kaun zyada tez hai. Yeh sab mere dost hain. Kya baat hai, itna tez? Tum ab kahan jaoge? Chalo, main bhi khel leta hoon. Yeh kaun hai jo beech mein ghus raha hai? Mika!
Rani! Mika! Tujhe darr nahi lagta? Nijak! Kisi ko takleef mat dena!
Bura khabar — Chris is baar muqabla nahi dekh payega. Kya? Muqabla? Tum sab ko yahan Arena ke liye laya gaya hai.

Yeh sabse bada muqabla hai, saare naye agents ke beech. Mission mein kaam karne ke saath saath, yahan tum apni asli salahiyat dikha sakte ho. Aur tum sab yahin rahoge, jab tak muqabla chal raha hai. Arena sath gharon par mashqoor hai... Lekin sawaal yeh hai — is saal Arena itni jaldi kyun? Kya hamare naye agents taiyaar hain? Yeh kisi ka plan ho sakta hai. Aur jo minimum points nahi layega, woh bahar. Sabse behtareen chaar teams seedha academy se grade hongi. Lekin sirf ek jeetega — Arena ka champion.
Subah bakhair. Tumne kya kiya? Tera aadaab kahan hai? Tumhe shukriya ada karna chahiye. Ruko. Hum kaise bach sakte hain?
Agent pembelot — woh gaddar hai!
Mere paas is island se nikalne ka raasta hai. Aur woh jaanta hai... use pachtana hoga.
Kya kar rahe ho? Pono khatam ho gaya. Hum ab free hain. Lekin tum mere saare mehnat ko bekaar kar rahe ho. Tum rukoge nahi, jab tak hum mata ka asli raaz nahi jaantay.
Dekhne ke liye shukriya.
